items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the science fiction story 'Feathered Friend', and answer.

"Aisha woke with a dull pain behind her eyes. The cabin was silent – too silent. The little canary that usually greeted her with a burst of song was floating, still and silent, beside its perch. In a second Aisha was wide awake. Something was wrong with the air."

Answer the following:
(i) How did Aisha feel when she woke?
(ii) Why did the cabin seem "too silent"?  (a) The engines had stopped forever  (b) Everyone had left  (c) The radio was off  (d) The canary was not singing as usual
(iii) Which quality does Aisha show?  (a) Carelessness  (b) Fear of birds  (c) Laziness  (d) Quick observation and reasoning
(iv) How is this passage like "Feathered Friend"?
items.answer: (i) She had a dull pain behind her eyes (a headache). (ii) (d) The canary was not singing as usual (iii) (d) Quick observation and reasoning (iv) In both, a canary's silence/unconsciousness warns of bad air before people realise it.
items.markingKey: (i) She had a dull pain behind her eyes (a headache). (ii) (d) The canary was not singing as usual (iii) (d) Quick observation and reasoning (iv) In both, a canary's silence/unconsciousness warns of bad air before people realise it. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
